List of symbols

TrEnCh project, Buckley Lab, Department of Biology, University of Washington

2026-04-29

Source: vignettes/Symbols.Rmd
Symbols.Rmd

The tables below compile the symbols which are used by TrenchR functions:

Parameters

Symbol

AA

Description

surface or cross-sectional area (m2m^2)

 ================:
aa altitude angle of the sun (degrees) (subscripts: s, for normal to a slope; c ,for the axis of a cylinder); solar absorptivity (proportion) (subscripts: ll, lizard thermal absorptivity; ss, lizard solar absorptivity) |
AcondfactAcondfact proportion of the animal surface area that is in contact with the ground
AgradfactAgradfact proportion of the animal projected area exposed to radiation from the ground
airpressureair_{pressure} air pressure (kPa)
aranaran scale performance value for performance curve? if aran = 0, no scaling; if aran = 1, includes a thermodynamic effect on mean performance
breadthbreadth breadth of the thermal performance curve
cc specific heat capacity (subscripts: aa, air; pp, air at constant pressure; soso, soil) (Jkg−1K−1J kg^{-1}K^{-1} or Jkg−1°C−1J kg^{-1}{°C}^{-1})
CTCT critical thermal limit (°C°C) (subscripts: min, minima; max, maxima), the lower and upper temperature limit for performance
DD characteristic dimension (mm); thoracic diameter (cmcm)
dd thickness of material (mm); diameter of a cylinder (mm)
dayday or doydoy day of year
degdeg angle (degrees)
depthdepth depth (cmcm)
ee water vapor pressure (Nm−2,mbarN m^{-2}, mbar) (subscripts: aa, of the air; ss, at saturation)
efef enhancement factor, used to adjust convective heat transfer coefficient to field conditions
elevelev elevation above mean sea level (mm).
FF view factor between the animal and radiation stream (dimensionless) (subscripts: aa, atmospheric radiation; dd, diffuse solar radiation; gg, ground thermal radiation; rr, reflected solar radiation)
gag_{a} a shape factor for soil particles | |
HLH_L or HH convective heat transfer coefficient (Wm−2°C−1W m^{-2}{°C}^{-1} or Wm−2K−1W m^{-2}K^{-1}) | |
hh height (mm); length of a cylinder (mm); relative humidity (decimal fraction); Planck’s constant (JsJ s); hour angle (rad) | |
hphp mean month relative humidity (percentage) | |
hourhour hour (0-24)
KK thermal conductance (Wm−2°C−1W m^{-2}{°C}^{-1}) (subscripts f, fur; g, substrate; s, skin; sf, skin and fur; o, overall heat conductance for an animal; c, surface boundary layer for convection; so, soil).
kk von Karman’s constant (dimensionless), k~0.41
ksok_{so} soil thermal conductivity (Wm−1K−1W m^{-1}K^{-1} or Wm−1C−1W m^{-1}C^{-1}) | |
KtK_t or ktkt clearness index, the ratio of the global solar radiation measured at the surface to the total solar radiation at the top of the atmosphere (dimensionless)
LL Monin-Obukhov length (mm), a measure of the instability of heat flow
ll or LL length (mm)
lonlon longitude (degrees)
latlat latitude (degrees)
LDTLDT lower developmental threshold (°C°C)
lwlw downward flux of near-infrared radiation (Wm−2Wm^{-2})
mm mass (kgkg or gg); air mass (dimensionless)
PP monthly precipitation (mmmm)
psapsa proportion surface exposed (dimensionless) (subscripts: airair, for exposure to air; refref, for exposure to ground; dirdir, for exposure to sky or enclosure; gg, for exposure to substrate)
QabsQ_{abs} solar and thermal radiation absorbed (WW)
QemitQ_{emit} thermal radiation emitted (WW)
QconvQ_{conv} energy exchange between an animal and the surrounding substance due to convection (WW)
QcondQ_{cond} energy exchange between an animal and the surface due to conduction (WW)
QmetQ_{met} energy emitted due to metabolism (WW)
QevapQ_{evap} energy emitted due to evaporative water loss (WW)
rr reflectance (decimal fraction) (subscripts: gg, of ground; SS, to direct sunlight; ss, to skylight); diffusion resistance to water vapor (sm−1s m^{-1}) (subscripts: bb, boundary layer; ii, internal or intercellular); resistance to heat flow (sm−1s m^{-1}) (subscripts: hh, haha, boundary layer; jj, diffusion resistance to molecular species j; radius (mm) (subscripts: bb, of inside body wall of animal; rr, of outer surface of animal)
radrad angle (radians)
razraz solar azimuth angle (degrees)
SS amount of sunlight incident upon the earth’s surface (Wm−2W m^{-2}) (subscripts: dirdir, direct solar radiation; difdif, diffuse solar radiation; hh, on a horizontal surface; refref, reflected solar radiation)
shadeshade whether soil temperature is calculated in the shade or not
shiftshift mode of the thermal performance curve
skewskew skewness of the thermal performance curve
sol.elevsol.elev solar elevation angles (degrees)
SSASSA solar absorptivity of soil surface (proportion)
svlsvl lizard snout vent length (mmmm)
tt time (hrhr or ss) (subscripts: asas, after sunset; nn, time of minimum temperature; rr, sunrise; ss, sunset; pp, rise the following day; xx, time of maximum temperature)
TT temperature (°C°C or KK or °F°F) (subscripts: aa, air; gg, ground; ss, surface; shsh, shade; skysky, effective radiant temperature of the sky)
TdewpointT_{dewpoint} dewpoint temperature (°C°C)
TeT_{e} Operative environmental temperature (°C°C)
TmaxT_{max} maximum temperature of the day (°C°C)
TminT_{min} minimum temperature of the day (°C°C)
TgmaxTg_{max} maximum soil surface temperature of the day (°C°C)
TgminTg_{min} minimum soil surface temperature of the day (°C°C)
ToptT_{opt} thermal optima, the temperature at which peak performance occurs (°C°C)
Tsoil0T_{soil0} initial soil temperature (°C°C)
tolerancetolerance maximal breath (°C°C) of the thermal performance curve
uu wind speed (ms−1m s^{-1}) (subscripts: rr, reference height or heights)
UDTUDT upper developmental threshold (°C°C)
VV volume (m3m^{3}) | |
watercontentwater_{content} water content (percent)
xx vector of volume fractions of soil constituents (e.g., clay, quartz, minerals other than quartz, organic matter, water, air)
zz distance, or height above a surface (mm) |
zrzr reference height (mm)
z0z0 roughness height (mm)

Greek Symbols

Symbol Description
α\alpha angle (rad or degrees); azimuth angle of the sun (degrees); time difference between time of maximum temperature and noon (hrhr) | |
β\beta slope angle, direction of normal from horizontal (degrees); time difference between time of maximum temperature and sunrise (hrhr)
δ\delta thoracic fur thickness (mmmm)
ϵ\epsilon emissivity (decimal fraction) (subscripts: aa, of atmosphere; ss, surface emissivity); angle (radian or degree); angle between axis of a cylinder and direction of the sun’s rays; equivalent temperature (°C°C); thermal absorptivity as a fraction (subscript: soso, soil)
γ\gamma decay parameter for rate of time change from sunset to time of minimum temperature
λ\lambda vector of the thermal conductivities (Wm−1K−1W m^{-1} K^{-1}) of the soil constituents
μ\mu dynamic viscosity (mols−1m−1mol\:s^{-1}m^{-1})
ν\nu kinematic viscosity coefficient (m2s−1m^2 s^{-1})
ψ\psi solar zenith angle (degrees)
ρ\rho density (kgm−3kg m^{-3}) (subscripts: aa, of dry air; jj, of molecular species; oo, of standard air; ww, of water vapor; soso, of soil); radius of a cylinder (mm); reflectivity (decimal fraction) (subscript: SS, surface albedo)
τ\tau atmospheric transmissivity (proportion) (subscripts: dd, to diffuse radiation; tt, to total radiation); thermal time constant (ss or hrhr) (superscript: aa, apparent)
θ\theta angle between the solar beam and the longitudinal axis (degrees)

Dimensionless Groups

Symbol Description
GrGr Grashof number
NuNu Nusselt number
ReRe Reynolds number
